test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 10 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Pranita, Subhash, Kamini, Ved, Yamini and Satya are sitting in a straight line facing the north. Ved is second to the left of Yamini. Pranita is to the immediate right of Kamini. Only Yamini is between Kamini and Satya. Subhash is to the immediate left of Ved. Who is sitting to the immediate right of Ved?
solution:
**Pranita, Subhash, Kamini, Ved, Yamini and Satya** are sitting in a straight line facing the north. 

1. Ved is second to the left of Yamini. 

2. Only Yamini is between Kamini and Satya. 

3. Subhash is to the immediate left of Ved.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0274cdb6c7246eb572031bae5fb78ace0d518893aa2bfd495f7fd47a1a327eb0.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4cd1e3aab219ec372f2e3b6988cfcb340a27a3180dde6455e8a346bdcf3e2d05.png] 

4. Pranita is to the immediate right of Kamini. 

 
• The above condition is possible only in Case I, as there is no right position vacant for Pranita to occupy in Case II.
 
• Also, it is clear from statement 4 that Kamini is sitting to the immediate right of Yamini, which leaves Kamini's immediate right position vacant for Pranita to occupy.
 
• Therefore, the final arrangement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4c9f9a9c09e9c048ca98598f38d997f24fbaf240e9810d6af4b8941976a6986.png] 

Clearly, Satya is sitting to the immediate right of Ved.

Hence, '**Satya**' is the correct answer.
